annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746 as regards a gradual roll-out of Eudamed, information obligation in case of interruption of supply and the transitional provisions for certain in vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746 as regards a gradual roll-out of Eudamed, information obligation in case of interruption of supply and the transitional provisions for certain in vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.summary_en: European Commission proposal amending the EU Medical Devices Regulation and In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation. It extends IVDR transitional periods to prevent shortages, allows gradual mandatory use of Eudamed modules, and requires manufacturers to give six months' notice before interrupting supply of critical devices. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends IVDR transitional periods to end-2027, 2028 and 2029 depending on risk class, subject to conditions
Requires a quality management system by 26 May 2025 and formal notified-body applications as conditions
Allows gradual mandatory use of individual Eudamed modules once declared functional
New Article 10a: six months' prior notice of supply interruption of critical devices
Coordinated assessment of clinical investigations becomes mandatory five years after voluntary start
